# project conventions (CLAUDE.md):
# Sustainable Barks — Claude Instructions

## Memory preference
When the user asks to remember something, write it to this CLAUDE.md file in addition to the auto-memory system under ~/.claude/projects/.

## Admin fee (internal — do not advertise)
SB takes a small admin fee to cover operating costs. Do NOT write "$0 admin fee," "no overhead," or similar claims anywhere on the site. "100% of profits donated to shelters" remains accurate (profit = revenue minus operating costs including admin). Do not reference the admin fee in any customer-facing copy.

## Tax language
A small admin fee is deducted for operating costs before shelter disbursement. Avoid claiming the *full* bundle payment is a charitable contribution — use language tied to the profit/proceeds, not the total payment:
- ✅ "100% of profits go to shelters"
- ✅ "Proceeds fund animal rescue shelters"
- ✅ "Tax-deductible" (as a label — exact deductible amount depends on the fee structure)
- ❌ "Your full bundle payment is a tax-deductible charitable contribution" — do not use while an admin fee exists
- ❌ "$0 admin fee" or "no overhead" — do not use
- ❌ "Consult your tax advisor" (do not add to selling copy; FAQ-only if needed)
A charitable contribution receipt is included with every order.

## Pricing (current as of May 2026)
- Essential Bundle: $75 (min 10)
- Signature Bundle: $95 (min 10) — most popular
- Luxury Bundle: $125 (min 5)
- All tiers include "Charitable contribution receipt"
- Bundles are toy-focused; treats are NOT advertised (may be included occasionally but not listed as a feature)


## Bundle structure (as of May 2026)
Each bundle covers multiple guest stays. Every tier gets identical service (dedicated contact, hand-inspected packages). Tiers differ only by stays covered and toys per stay. Cost per stay decreases as tier increases.

- Essential $75: 10 stays × 5 toys = 50 toys rescued. $7.50/stay. Min 10 bundles (100 stays).
- Signature $95: 15 stays × 6 toys = 90 toys rescued. $6.33/stay. Min 10 bundles (150 stays). Most popular.
- Luxury $125: 25 stays × 7 toys = 175 toys rescued. $5.00/stay. Min 5 bundles (125 stays).

Every stay includes: shelter-sourced toys + welcome card + sustainable packaging.
Hotel receives: 1 charitable contribution receipt per bundle order.
Luxury upgrade: hotel-branded welcome card instead of standard.

DO NOT advertise: spotlight cards, bandanas, seasonal toys, gift boxes, treats, "white-glove," "priority fulfillment" — none of these are currently offe
